rates.descriptionEn: The displayed online rate is for 60 minutes on one floodlit indoor clay court, without a coach. Check the price for your selected time in the schedule; pay at the venue.

businesses.qualification: The current merchant timetable exposes a EUR 20 rate for sixty minutes at two lighted indoor clay courts. The allocation is a court rental with payment at the venue, not a lesson or a guaranteed price for future dates. The separate outdoor court lacks a current visible fare in this review and was excluded. No platform membership discount, ordinary opening hours, on-site GoRez booking, or live GoRez slots were inferred.
businesses.identityCheck: Public phone, named merchant and location were compared with existing local catalogue entries and aliases; no duplicate club location. Compare the actual merchant profile rather than only the shared booking-platform hostname.
